max_units_note: --max-units is a ceiling on READER requests, checked between batches. One read can buy the unit plus two split halves, so a run can exceed it by at most DRIVER_UNIT_HEADROOM-1 (2) requests, once, when the last batch it begins will not parse. Checker requests are counted separately as checker_units and are never capped by it.
